summary.en: US futures steady after Asian tech selloff as Treasury buybacks calm long-end yields. Moderna surges 177% on melanoma vaccine breakthrough while oil climbs near $92 amid Hormuz tensions. DXY slips below 99, gold rallies toward $4,500.
summary.zh: 美股期货在亚洲科技股抛售后企稳，国债买盘压低长期收益率。Moderna 因黑色素瘤疫苗突破飙升 177%，油价受霍尔木兹海峡紧张局势影响升至近 92 美元。美元指数跌破 99，黄金反弹至 4500 美元附近。

title.en: Moderna's Melanoma Vaccine Passes Phase 3 Trial, Stock Soars 177%
title.zh: Moderna 黑色素瘤疫苗通过三期试验，股价飙升 177%

topNews.impact: Historic mRNA cancer therapy success with Merck partnership reduces melanoma recurrence risk; catalyst for biotech sector and broader healthcare rally.

macroRisk.zh: 否 - 生物技术创新事件

title.en: Oil Prices Rise for Fifth Session as Hormuz Standoff Keeps WTI/Brent Near $92
title.zh: 油价连涨五日，霍尔木兹僵局令 WTI/Brent 原油接近 92 美元

topNews.impact: Middle East tensions elevate supply risks; geopolitical premium weighs on inflation expectations and energy sector positioning.

macroRisk.en: Yes - stagflation risk via oil → inflation → Treasury yields
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 油价推升通胀预期传导至国债收益率

title.en: Treasury Doubles Buybacks, Yields Fall from 4.71% to 4.65%
title.zh: 财政部加倍买盘，收益率从 4.71% 降至 4.65%

topNews.impact: Technical yield relief provides temporary respite for rate-sensitive equities; longer-term fundamentals remain challenging.

macroRisk.en: Yes - stagflation regime persists despite Treasury intervention
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 国债干预难改滞胀格局

ai.en: Chip-led selloff extends overnight; SK Hynix, Samsung Electronics drop 7% on tech rout. AI hardware and semiconductor equipment names under pressure from stagflation fears.
ai.zh: 芯片抛售延续至盘后，SK 海力士、三星电子跌 7%。AI 硬件和半导体设备股受滞胀担忧压制。

semiconductor.en: Broad-based weakness across fabless and equipment; KOLM (Korea) -5.8%, Japan semiconductor index mirrors Asian decline. Inventory normalization amid demand slowdown.
semiconductor.zh: 无晶圆厂和设备股全面走弱；韩国 COLM 跌 5.8%，日半指数同步亚洲下滑。需求放缓下的库存去化。

bigTech.en: Futures pause on tech-led losses following overnight decline; NVDA, MSFT names slip as rate sensitivity limits upside despite strong earnings expectations.
bigTech.zh: 隔夜下跌后科技领跌，期货暂停；NVDA、MSFT 受利率敏感压制上行空间。

energy.en: WTI near $88-90, Brent approaching $92; Hormuz disruption fears drive risk premium. OPEC+ production discipline supports pricing power in inflationary environment.
energy.zh: WTI 近 88-90，Brent 近 92 美元；霍尔木兹中断担忧推升风险溢价。OPEC+ 增产纪律在通胀环境下支撑定价权。

ev.en: Auto sector lags on broader market weakness; EV-specific names underperform as chip shortage relief fails to offset macro headwinds.
ev.zh: 整车板块跟随大盘走弱；EV 个股跑输，芯片短缺缓解难抵宏观逆风。

market.en: Futures flat to slightly lower after three-day decline; S&P 500 contracts slip 0.3%, Nasdaq down 0.5% as tech sells off. Healthcare gains offset broader weakness.
market.zh: 三连跌后期货持平微跌；标普合约跌 0.3%，纳指跌 0.5%。医药股上涨抵消大盘疲软。

preciousMetals.en: Gold rallies toward $4,500 as yields fall and DXY weakens; silver lags ahead of Fed minutes. Real rates decline supports precious metals flight-to-safety.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金反弹至 4500 美元附近，收益率和美元指数走弱；金银在美联储纪要前表现分化。实际利率下行助推避险属性。

oil.en: WTI extends four-day advance, Brent near $92. Geopolitical risk premium from Middle East tensions; Hormuz closure scenario keeps supply concerns elevated.
oil.zh: WTI 延续四日上涨，Brent 近 92 美元。中东紧张局势的风险溢价；霍尔木兹关闭情景维持供应担忧。

futures.en: S&P 500 futures steady to slightly lower after Friday's close; Nasdaq contracts down ~0.5% on tech selloff
futures.zh: 标普期货在周五收盘后持平微跌；纳指合约因科技抛售下跌约 0.5%

treasury10Y.en: US 10-year yield falls to ~4.65% after Treasury buyback intervention from intraday high of 4.712%
treasury10Y.zh: 美债 10 年期收益率因财政部干预从日内高点 4.712% 回落至约 4.65%

dxy.en: DXY slips below 99.00 on Treasury yields decline and Fed repricing expectations
dxy.zh: 美元指数在国债收益率下降和美联储重新定价预期下跌破 99.00

oil.en: WTI/Brent near $88-92 range as Hormuz tensions elevate geopolitical risk premium
oil.zh: WTI/Brent 原油受霍尔木兹紧张局势影响在 88-92 美元区间波动

keyRisk.en: Stagflation regime with oil-driven inflation undermining rate-cut expectations; tech selloff reflects fundamentals under macro stress
keyRisk.zh: 油价推升通胀破坏降息预期的滞胀格局；科技股抛售反映宏观压力下基本面受损

note.en: Mixed session with biotech rally (Moderna) offsetting tech/semiconductor weakness. Macro regime challenges (stagflation, yield pressure) limit broad upside despite short-term catalysts.
note.zh: 板块分化：生物技术股（Moderna）反弹抵消科技股/半导体疲软。宏观格局挑战（滞胀、收益率压力）限制广泛上行空间，尽管存在短期催化。
